GET https://admin.googleapis.com/admin/reports
/v1/activity/users/all/applications/meet?
eventName=dialed_out&maxResults=10
&access_token=YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN
The endpoint performed an action that requires
to be reported
An event indicating that everyone can send chat messages.
Event details
Event name
send_chat_everyone
Parameters
action_time
string
Action time.
conference_id
string
The unique identifier of the conference.
identifier
string
The unique participant identifier (for
example, an email address, phone
number, or device ID).
identifier_type
string
Indicates the type of the participant
identifier. Possible values:
device_id
The unique device identifier of the
Meet hardware.
email_address
The participant's email address.
Visible when the participant is in-
domain or when the meeting is
organized by a user who is in-
domain.
phone_number
The participant's telephone number.
is_external
boolean
Indicates if the participant is external
to your organization.
meeting_code
string
The meeting code for the Google Meet
conference (for example, 'abc-hexp-
tqy'). Recurrent meetings have the
same meeting code.
Sample request
Admin Console message format
GET https://admin.googleapis.com/admin/reports
/v1/activity/users/all/applications/meet?
eventName=send_chat_everyone&maxResults=10
&access_token=YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN
A host turned on in-call messages for everyone.
